architectural_finding: Gradients do physically flow through cond_mlp to action embeddings. However, because cond_mlp produces a single global FiLM scale (gamma) and shift (beta) broadcast identically across all 64 spatial tokens, and the 64 tokens are processed by self-attention without any dedicated action token in the sequence, the transformer self-attention is free to attend purely to the spatial tokens, causing action divergence to remain vanishingly small (10^-5 to 10^-6).
